name: SignFuz
author: M A Vinoth Kumar

sections.description:
SignFuz is a self-hosted electronic signature and document workflow engine for WordPress. Create, send, sign, manage, verify, and retain business documents directly on your own WordPress infrastructure with zero mandatory third-party SaaS fees.

Key Features

  • Self-Hosted Privacy: Keep documents and signing evidence entirely on your own infrastructure with zero mandatory monthly fees.
  • Visual PDF Editor: Place signature, name, date, and text fields on PDF documents with pixel-perfect precision.
  • Multi-Party Signatures: Add unlimited signers per agreement with parallel (concurrent) or sequential (ordered 1 → 2 → 3) workflows.
  • Reusable Templates: Create blueprint templates with dynamic role placeholders (e.g., Client, Witness) and spawn new envelopes in one click.
  • PIN & Access Code Gate: Protect sensitive documents with an access code/PIN verification gate and rate-limited brute-force guards.
  • Public Self-Serve Kiosk: Deploy walk-up client agreement kiosks via [signfuz_kiosk] shortcode or direct URL for tablets.
  • Automated Reminders & Expirations: Automated WP-Cron reminders to signers with configurable intervals and automated expiration dates.
  • Branding & Customization: Customize legal organization name, brand accent colors, and custom email footer signatures.
  • Frontend Dashboard Bridge: Dedicated client portal tab and [signfuz_my_documents] shortcode for logged-in users to manage and download signed PDFs.
  • WorkFuz Integration: Automatically sign off deliverables and milestones when linked document envelopes are completed.
  • Cryptographic Evidence Trail: Records signer consent, IP addresses, user agents, timestamps, and immutable SHA-256 event chains.
  • Automated Certificate of Completion: Generates tamper-evident audit certificates sealing completed documents with verification hashes.
  • Private Storage Vault: Protects source PDFs and completed artifacts behind authenticated streaming controllers.

Build Instructions

The user interface of SignFuz is built using React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. The complete, unminified source code is included within this plugin package in the src/ directory.

To build the production assets from source:

  1. Ensure you have Node.js (v18 or higher) and npm installed.
  2. Open a terminal and navigate to the plugin directory:
    cd wp-content/plugins/sign-fuz
  3. Install dependencies:
    npm install
  4. Compile the production bundles:
    npm run build

The build output is automatically generated in assets/dist/:
* assets/dist/admin.js — Compiled React application bundle.
* assets/dist/admin.css — Compiled Tailwind CSS stylesheet.
* assets/dist/pdf.worker.min.mjs — Local PDF.js background rendering worker.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the sign-fuz folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access SignFuz in your WordPress Admin sidebar to start managing agreements.
sections.faq:
Does SignFuz rely on external signing SaaS services?

No. SignFuz operates completely on your own WordPress server and database without mandatory third-party subscriptions.

Where are PDF documents stored?

Documents are stored in a private vault directory protected against direct web access.

Can I add multiple signers to a document?

Yes. You can add multiple recipients per agreement and choose whether they sign concurrently (Parallel) or sequentially in numbered order.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Major Release: Unified enterprise electronic signature engine into core with zero restrictions or external licensing.
  • Unified Architecture: Integrated reusable document templates, signer PIN security gates, self-serve walk-up kiosk mode, and automated email reminders directly into core.
  • Administrative Settings: Added dedicated Settings menu (SignFuz -> Settings) for organization legal branding, accent colors, reminder schedules, and expiration policies.
  • Multi-Signer Workflows: Full parallel and sequential signing sequences without artificial restrictions.
  • Frontend & Ecosystem Integration: Included Frontend Dashboard client portal bridge ([signfuz_my_documents]) and WorkFuz deliverable sign-off integration.
  • Code Standards: Standardized asset enqueueing, eliminated inline assets, and verified full compliance with WordPress.org plugin directory guidelines.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of SignFuz.
  • Database schema for documents, envelopes, signers, fields, and events.
  • Private file storage vault.
  • REST API endpoints for document and envelope management.
